run_diatomic_curve_computation: run a diatomic potential energy curve computation for a given pair of atoms using a pretrained MLIP model
run_diatomic_tests_cli: run the diatomic tests CLI script to compute and plot potential energy curves for multiple atom pairs
generate_diatomic_energy_plot: generate a matplotlib plot of the diatomic potential energy curve for a specific atom pair
generate_combined_plot: generate a combined matplotlib plot showing potential energy curves for multiple atom pairs on one graph
load_pretrained_mlip_model: load a pretrained machine learning interatomic potential model for energy prediction on atomic data
